helper(x: int): int {
    return x * 2;
}

[Test]
doubles() {
    expect_equal(helper(2), 4);
    expect_true(helper(1) == 2);
    expect_false(helper(0) == 1);
    expect_not_equal("a", "b");
}

[Test]
doubles_wrongly() {
    expect_equal(helper(2), 5);
}

[Test]
[ShouldPanic("out of bounds")]
reads_past_the_end() {
    var numbers = Array<int>();
    var value = numbers[0];
}

[Test]
[ShouldPanic]
returns_instead() {}

[Test]
spins() {
    while (true) {}
}

main(): int {
    print("the program's own main");
    return 0;
}
